_comment: Single source of truth for the /explore/ card wall and pack pages. Add a pack or a chapter here, drop in the chapter's index.html, done — no code changes, no build step.

packs.title: Co-Teaching in the Taiwanese Classroom
packs.title_zh: 台灣教室裡的協同教學
packs.blurb: Why you have a co-teacher, the six ways two teachers can share a room, and what to do when the two of you disagree.
packs.blurb_zh: 為什麼會有協同老師、兩個老師共用一間教室的六種方式，以及意見不合時怎麼談。

chapters.title: The System You're In
chapters.blurb: Co-teaching is written into national policy, not invented by your school. Here is what your local co-teacher is accountable for that you are not — and why that explains most of the friction.

chapters.title: Six Ways to Share a Classroom
chapters.title_zh: 共用一間教室的六種方式
chapters.blurb: The six recognized co-teaching models mapped onto a Taiwanese English class, why almost every pair defaults to the one that leaves both of them unhappy, and the two worth proposing instead.

chapters.title: When You Disagree
chapters.blurb: Both sides are already on record in the research. How to sort what is structural from what is yours from what is actually worth a conversation — and how to open that conversation without losing the room.

packs.title: Changhua Worth Visiting
packs.blurb: Not a tourist brochure — how to actually get there this weekend. Which train, which bus, which day to avoid, what to eat, the Mandarin you'll need on the spot, and what to do with it in class on Monday.
packs.blurb_zh: 不是旅遊簡介，是這個週末怎麼真的去成：搭哪班車、避開哪一天、吃什麼、現場用得到的中文，以及星期一回到教室怎麼用。

chapters.title: Lukang in One Day
chapters.blurb: Taiwan's second city for a century, then the harbor silted up and it stopped growing — which is why it is still standing. Getting there without a car, four things worth your time, what to eat, temple manners, and eight sentences you will actually say.

chapters.title: The West Coast: Wanggong and the Tidal Flats
chapters.blurb: Oyster farms, carts out onto the mudflats at low tide, Taiwan's tallest lighthouse, and a sunset most people who live here have never gone to watch. Plan the whole day backwards from the tide.

chapters.title: Changhua City on Foot
chapters.blurb: The Great Buddha on Bagua Mountain, the last working roundhouse in Taiwan, and a Confucian temple older than most of the island's cities — all within walking distance of the train station.

packs.title: Designing What You Teach
packs.title_zh: 教學設計：教案、學習單、互動題
packs.blurb: Lesson plans that survive a co-taught class, worksheets students can finish without you standing over them, and Apps Script for interactive questions that write straight back to your own site.
packs.blurb_zh: 撐得住協同課堂的教案、學生不用你站在旁邊也做得完的學習單，以及用 Apps Script 做會把作答回寫到自己網站的互動題目。

chapters.title: Writing a Lesson Plan Two People Can Teach
chapters.title_zh: 寫一份兩個人教得起來的教案
chapters.blurb: A plan for a co-taught class has a job an ordinary plan does not: it has to tell the other teacher what they are doing, minute by minute, without a conversation.

chapters.title: Making a Worksheet That Actually Works
chapters.title_zh: 做一張真的有用的學習單
chapters.blurb: Why most worksheets fail in the first ninety seconds, how to write instructions a student can follow in a second language, and how to build in something for the fastest and slowest child in the room.

chapters.title: Apps Script: Questions That Write Back to Your Site
chapters.title_zh: Apps Script：會回寫到你網站的互動題目
chapters.blurb: Build interactive questions your students answer on your Google Site, with the responses landing in a sheet you control — so you can see who is stuck without collecting any paper.
